skill.label: ファッション：ベーシックカラーとトレンドカラーの分類

derivationRule: Use only the fixed nonvisual intersection: basic colors are repeatedly used standard-color categories not defined by the current fashion trend; trend colors are fashion color-trend categories whose content changes with era/season; JAFCA publishes fashion trend-color information. Do not infer universal classifications for particular hues, current trend status from displayed colors or photographs, RGB/HEX, sampled pixels, monitor appearance, or unstated style geometry.
